categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment for industries including semiconductors, LED, capacitors, and lithium batteries. Key product lines include LED die bonding machines, semiconductor die bonding and wire bonding machines, capacitor aging test equipment, and lithium battery winding and tab cutting machines. The company also provides integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions and has subsidiaries focusing on automation and vacuum equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-speed precise motion control, direct-drive vector control, embedded floating-point real-time multi-path motion control, automatic tracking and correction, machine vision high-speed positioning, and Mini LED defect detection algorithms. It has developed proprietary core components including drivers, high-precision DDR motors, linear motors, voice coil motors, motion control cards, and integrated controllers. Production employs ERP and MES systems for process management, with a focus on automation and intelligent control to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xinyichang serves leading domestic and international companies in semiconductor packaging and testing, LED display manufacturing, capacitor production, and lithium battery manufacturing. Notable customers include Huawei, Samsung Electronics, BOE, Sanan Optoelectronics, and various top capacitor and LED manufacturers. The company targets markets requiring high-precision intelligent manufacturing equipment, focusing on sectors such as semiconductor packaging, Mini/Micro LED display production, capacitor aging testing, and lithium battery assembly.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It also has overseas sales, though international revenue declined significantly in 2023 due to global economic uncertainties. The company aims to expand its global market presence by aligning with international customers' globalized industrial layouts and increasing export sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyichang operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and supplying intelligent manufacturing equipment and solutions to downstream semiconductor, LED, capacitor, and lithium battery manufacturers. It also produces some core components in-house, enabling vertical integration within its equipment production process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on developing high-precision, intelligent manufacturing equipment for Mini/Micro LED, semiconductors, capacitors, and lithium batteries. It emphasizes core component self-development and production to reduce reliance on external suppliers. Future R&D plans include expanding product lines, enhancing software intelligence, integrating equipment with cloud and MES systems, and collaborating with research institutions to maintain technological leadership and support domestic substitution of imported equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Xinyichang generates revenue primarily through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment to industrial customers, supplemented by sales of parts and maintenance services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, with some overseas sales conducted through agents. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery, customer acceptance, and receipt of payment or payment confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in LED die bonding machines and capacitor aging test equipment, with growing market share in semiconductor packaging equipment. It competes against international firms from the Netherlands, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan. Xinyichang differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, core component self-production, and deep customer relationships, positioning itself as a domestic leader and aspiring international first-class intelligent manufacturing solutions provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Xinyichang reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.04 billion, a 12.12% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 60.3 million, down 70.55%. Despite revenue decline due to macroeconomic and industry downturns, the company maintains a substantial scale with total assets of RMB 2.61 billion and net assets of RMB 1.39 billion. R&D investment increased to 9.28% of revenue, supporting future growth. The company has a workforce of 1,504 employees, including 344 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyichang emphasizes its strong independent R&D and innovation capabilities, enabling it to develop high-precision, intelligent manufacturing equipment with integrated software and hardware solutions. Its ability to self-develop and produce core components reduces costs and improves product quality and delivery speed. The company offers customized solutions aligned with customer application scenarios, ensuring high efficiency, precision, and reliability. Its products support domestic substitution of imported equipment, meeting stringent industry standards and fostering long-term partnerships with leading manufacturers.
